notes.content:
Hey there, Battlemages!

A PC update releases today, June 7, with fixes for HDR and DLSS. Your feedback helps us make Immortals of Aveum the best game it can be, so please keep sharing your thoughts, bug reports, and suggestions! 

[b]Key Fixes: [/b]
[list]
[*] Saved HDR settings will now persist and display accurately with each relaunch of the game. Addressed an issue where after the user set HDR to ‘on’, closing and relaunching the game caused HDR Mode to turn ‘off’ while the toggle button continued to display ‘on’.

[/list]

See the previous update’s patch notes [url=https://answers.ea.com/t5/Immortals-of-Aveum/Immortals-of-Aveum-Update-1-0-6-4-Patch-Notes/td-p/13750400]here[/url].

notes.title: AMD FSR 3 and HDR Updates Arrive in Immortals of Aveum!
notes.content:
The FSR 3 update you've all been waiting for is here! We’re also rolling out HDR (high dynamic range) to PC in this patch ([url=https://steamcommunity.com/games/2009100/announcements/detail/4191240933887102144]read the patch notes here[/url]). 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43953575/191d104ebdc8ca9a3d2a9f97cdcaa5f2dec68dd3.jpg[/img]

[h1]Bringing Improvements & Enhancements to Immortals of Aveum[/h1] 

Since launch, our team has been hard at work to improve and enhance the game, including adding highly-requested features like HDR and New Game +. With today’s patch, we’re pleased to bring you part two of our big FSR 3 and HDR update.

So, whether you’re a new recruit or haven’t had a chance to catch up on the latest IOA news, here’s a quick recap of updates, features, and content added to Immortals of Aveum over the past several months:
[list]
[*] HDR on all platforms 
[*] AMD FSR 3 with frame generation on all platforms 
[*] FSR 3 support for VRR displays on all platforms 
[*] Improvements to FSR 3 on PC
[*] New endgame objectives and boss battle in “The Echollector” gameplay update
[*] New Game +
[*] Tougher challenges in the new “Grand Magnus” difficulty mode
[*] Key fixes to DLSS
[*] Improvements to mouse settings, such as mouse sensitivity 
[*] Console brightness adjustments and added a Gamma Correction slider
[*] Tons of other performance improvements, bug fixes, and game enhancements 
[/list]

Now is the perfect time to unearth the mysteries of Aveum. We hope you enjoy the beautiful visuals, improved framerates & improved performance, Battlemages!  

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43953575/590b5ce23d0f92a6ff40c99eabf222a4b98b1353.jpg[/img]

[h1]AMD FSR 3 Updates Arrive on PC[/h1]

FSR 3 uses a combination of super resolution temporal upscaling technology and frame generation to deliver smoother framerates in supported games. This technology uses optical flow technology and temporal game data such as motion vectors to generate additional high-quality frames for a higher framerate. On PC, FSR 3 has been updated to a newer, better version which further improves visual quality and performance of its temporal upscaling. 

And there’s more - This update also extends support for VRR monitors and TVs on all platforms, which improves frame pacing and reduces occurrences of judder or screen tear. Now all Immortals of Aveum players can enjoy better quality visuals, improved framerates, and improved game performance on an even broader set of hardware, thanks to AMD FSR 3 and our partners at [url=https://enduring.games/]Enduring Games[/url]. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43953575/4bddf117a5a3a8b011009ddd174f4cccfb5f4275.jpg[/img]

[h1]HDR is Now Available on PC! 
[/h1]
We’re pleased to bring HDR (high dynamic range) to PC with today’s update, patch 1.0.6.4. Now PC  battlemages alike can explore Aveum’s stunning landscapes and wield deadly spells in magical first-person combat all in gorgeous HDR with deeper shadows, brighter highlights, and more vibrant colors.

HDR is one of the IOA community’s most highly requested features and our team shared that desire to bring HDR to Immortals of Aveum. This meant taking the time to make the game look great in both SDR and HDR and balancing work on other unannounced projects. We wanted to provide players with gorgeous HDR visuals, and we’re delighted to offer a richer, more visually captivating journey through Aveum we hope all battlemages will enjoy. 

[h1]Stay In Touch[/h1]

If you want to be first to know about updates like this, plus get insights into game lore, chat with fellow Magni, and even meet some of the dev team, then head over to [url=https://discord.com/invite/immortalsofaveum?utm_source=ascendantstudios.beehiiv.com&utm_medium=newsletter&utm_campaign=immortals-of-aveum-is-live]the official Immortals of Aveum Discord server[/url]. Check out our gameplay Deep Dives and behind-the-scenes studio footage on [url=https://www.youtube.com/channel/UCLriT0KpGHplTdSBKHlXiIQ]our YouTube channel[/url]. You can also subscribe to our newsletter, [url=https://ascendantstudios.beehiiv.com/subscribe]The Standup[/url], and follow us on [url=http://www.twitter.com/ascendantstudio]Twitter[/url], [url=https://www.tiktok.com/@ascendantstudios]TikTok[/url], [url=https://www.instagram.com/ascendant_studios/]Instagram[/url], and [url=https://www.linkedin.com/company/ascendantstudios/]LinkedIn [/url]to keep up with Immortals of Aveum. If you’re into game development and want to hear from the OG’s of the industry, listen to our original podcast series, [url=https://anchor.fm/ascendantstudios]Rise Above[/url].

notes.title: Immortals of Aveum Patch 1.0.6.4 Release Notes
notes.content:
Greetings Battlemages! 

We’ve got an exciting tech update coming to you in patch 1.0.6.4 on May 24, 2024. This update rolls out HDR (high dynamic range) and brings an updated version of AMD FidelityFX™ Super Resolution 3 (FSR 3) to PC. It also means Immortals of Aveum™ is the first game to implement AMD FidelityFX™ Super Resolution 3 (FSR 3) on PlayStation 5 and Xbox Series X|S! Console and PC players alike can now take advantage of FSR 3’s super resolution temporal upscaling, advanced frame generation, and built-in latency reduction technology to boost framerates and game performance. This update also extends FSR 3 support for Variable Refresh Rate (VRR) monitors and TVs on all platforms. 

Now all Immortals of Aveum players can enjoy better quality visuals, improved framerates, and improved game performance on an even broader set of hardware thanks to AMD FSR 3 and our incredibly talented partners at Enduring Games. Read more about today’s update in this blog post.

As always, we’re grateful to each and every player who has spent time in Aveum. It’s your love for this game that fuels our studio. Please keep sharing your feedback, thoughts, and suggestions! 

[b]Key Updates: [/b]
[list]
[*] [i]Immortals of Aveum[/i] is now running AMD FidelityFX™ Super Resolution 3 (FSR 3) on PlayStation 5 and Xbox Series X|S, and PC!
[*] FSR 3 uses a combination of super resolution temporal upscaling technology and advanced frame generation to deliver smoother framerates, better image quality, and improved game performance.
[*] On PC, AMD FSR 3 has been updated to a newer, better version which further improves visual quality and performance of its temporal upscaling. 
[*] On console and PC, the FSR 3 update also extends support for Variable Refresh Rate (VRR) monitors and TVs, which can improve frame pacing to help reduce judder or screen tears
[*] HDR (high dynamic range) support is now available on PC to enhance players’ gaming experience with more detailed and realistic visuals. HDR arrived on consoles in the previous game update, patch 1.0.6.3.
[*] HDR is set to ‘off’ by default and can be adjusted in the Graphics menu. 
[*] Known Issue: After the user sets HDR to ‘on’, closing and relaunching the game causes HDR Mode to turn ‘off’ while the toggle button continues to display ‘on’. We’re working to release a hot fix for this as quickly as possible. 
[*] Temporary Workaround: When relaunching the game, toggle HDR to ‘off’ > save settings > toggle HDR to ‘on’ > save settings
[/list]
[b]PC Updates:[/b]
[list]
[*] Fixed an audio bug when switching language settings in game. The game will now apply the correct audio voice over for the selected language.  
[*] Updated to NVIDIA DLSS 3.7 and NVIDIA Streamline 2.4 which can help further improve image quality and game performance for PCs utilizing the latest NVIDIA RTX GPUs.
[*] Fixed a rare issue with NVIDIA cards that could cause the game to crash when using Alt+Tab.
[/list]
[b]Misc. Changes & Minor Fixes: [/b]
[list]
[*] Addressed minor bugs and progression blockers
[*] Addressed instances of occasional crashes 
[*] Minor addition of localized text 
[/list]

notes.title: Update 1.0.6.1
notes.content:
Hey, Battlemages! 

An update with a hot fix for New Game+ is headed your way today, November 21st, for PlayStation 5, Xbox Series X|S and PC. We’re continuing work, bringing even more fixes and improvements to [i]Immortals of Aveum[/i]™, so stay tuned!  

[h3]Key Fixes: [/h3]
[list]
[*] New Game+ is now unlocked for all players who have reached the “Epilogue” objective. This resolves an incident where some players would be locked out of accessing New Game+ despite meeting the requirements. 
[*] Removed the text that appears above the New Game+ altar outside of Glaivegate. 
[/list]
[h3]General Updates:[/h3]
[list]
[*] Fixed instances of occasional crashes, particularly on minimum or below minimum spec machines 
[*] Resolved an issue where respawning during a reload animation sometimes prevented Jak from being able to fire the sigil. 
[*] Convinced a stubborn Swordsman to gracefully accept his fate when falling to his death inside the Holosteric Shatterfane so players can progress with the fight.  
[*] Fixed an occasional issue where players would respawn in a freefall inside the Wild Fane. 
[*] The Hand of Sandrakk’s mastery of Blue magic grows and she is now immune to Vortex. This also addresses an issue in New Game+ where using Vortex against The Hand could cause a bug that prevented the fight from progressing. 
[*] Various performance improvements throughout the game. 
[/list]

notes.title: The Echollector Update & Free Demo are Here!
notes.content:
Greetings Battlemages! 

The Echollector Update* arrives today, November 16th, on PlayStation 5, Xbox Series X|S and PC, along with the console Free Trial and PC Demo! We’ve got all the details in the patch notes below (including some spoilers). But don’t take our word for it, go check it out in game now! 

[previewyoutube=iVliWy20CMQ;full][/previewyoutube]

[h3]New Game+: [/h3]
[list]
[*] We’ve added New Game+ as an option to begin a new playthrough while preserving key progression features.
[*] The player starts New Game+ as a Magnus in the Light’s Army. The new playthrough begins in the Yltheum Chapter, bypassing the introductory Streetwise and The Magnus Chapters. 
[*] Gear, resources, talents, Arcanum, and health and mana upgrades carry over from the previous playthrough.
[*] All unlocked spells and abilities carry over EXCEPT Augment spells (Grapple, Disrupt, Animate, etc.) due to their unlock requirements. 
[*] Epic and Legendary gear can be upgraded to higher levels in the Forge.
[*] Enemy health, damage, and abilities have been rebalanced, and experience and currency earned have been adjusted to scale with New Game+ progression. 
[/list]

[b]How to access:[/b] NG+ is available from a shrine behind Zendara in Glaivegate following the final boss battle battle. You do not need to 100% the game to start NG+

[h3]Grand Magnus Difficulty Mode:[/h3]
[list]
[*] We’ve added the new “Grand Magnus” game difficulty option that provides players with tougher combat challenges throughout the game. 
[*] “Grand Magnus” difficulty can be selected anytime, whether it’s your first playthrough or you’re starting New Game+. 
[*] Enemy health, defense, power, and behavior have been adjusted. 
[*] Combat is more intense, there are fewer health drops, and swapping between spells and abilities will be essential to survival. 
[/list]

[h3]“The Echollector” Gameplay Update: SPOILERS ALERT[/h3]
[list]
[*]  “The Echollector” gameplay update brings new endgame objectives to Immortals of Aveum™. Spoilers lie below, so skip ahead if you’d prefer to experience it all in the game first.[list]
[*] The new content automatically becomes available when the player reaches Glaivegate.
[*] Shatterfanes - these are corrupted Shroudfanes that lead to new hidden areas and tough battles. 
[*] New Gear - Within the Shatterfanes, players will be rewarded with all-new gear items to take on their journey, including a new bracer, two rings, Limpets vial, and a legendary sigil. 
[*] Discover new lore and face an epic boss battle with the ancient being, The Echollector. [/list] [/list]

[b]How to access:[/b] The four fanes are in Pale Forest, Shrineforge, Oremen, and Glaivegate. To progress through the Acroamatic Fane (the fourth and final fane in Glaivegate), you need to beat the other 3 fanes.

[h3]Console Free Trial & PC Demo:[/h3]
[list]
[*] New players can now begin their adventure in the Immortals of Aveum Free Trial on PlayStation 5 and Xbox Series X|S or in the PC Demo on Steam**! For all the details and to access the Free Trial and Demo, [url=https://www.ea.com/games/immortals-of-aveum/immortals-of-aveum/free-trial]go here[/url]. 
[*] The Free Trial goes live on PlayStation 5 and Xbox Series X|S, and the PC Demo goes live on Steam at 9am PST (5pm UTC) on November 16, 2023. 
[*] Accessing the Free Trial on PlayStation 5 or Xbox Series X|S:[list]
[*] The Free Trial can be accessed by downloading the app from the Immortals of Aveum [url=https://store.playstation.com/en-us/product/UP0006-PPSA08236_00-ARTEMISGAME00000/]PlayStation Store page[/url] or the [url=https://www.xbox.com/en-US/games/store/Immortals-of-Aveum/9NSD4HTWM8HT]Microsoft Store Page[/url]. [/list]
[*] Accessing the PC Demo on Steam:
[*] The PC Demo can be accessed by visiting the Immortals of Aveum [list]
[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/2009100/Immortals_of_Aveum/]Steam Store page[/url]. [/list]
[*] Free Trial and PC Demo Content:[list]
[*] Play through the first three chapters of Immortals of Aveum, starting at the beginning of the game through the Yltheum Chapter.  
[*] Player progression in the Free Trial or PC Demo will carry over to the full game when Immortals of Aveum is purchased on that respective platform. [/list] [/list]

[h3]General Updates:[/h3]
[list]
[*] Addressed how the player interacts with an object to prevent accidentally crushing a Mana crystal
[*] On PC, we’ve added an option to turn off mouse smoothing which can help improve the feel of high DPI mice 
[*] Added FPS cap on PC
[*] Addressed an issue where a player could occasionally get stuck in a freefall inside a Shroudfane 
[*] Made it so enemies leave behind their loot even if they fall into the abyss
[*] Fixed instances of occasional crashes and progression blockers
[*] Addressed rumors of a new Beast among Rasharn’s ranks still lurking within the borders of Kalthus
[*] Updated Privacy Policy document [/list]


See the previous update’s patch notes [url=https://answers.ea.com/t5/Immortals-of-Aveum/Immortals-of-Aveum-Patch-1-0-5-5-Release-Notes/td-p/13147605]here[/url]. 

*Requires Immortals of Aveum (sold separately) and all game updates.

**Conditions and restrictions apply. See https://www.ea.com/games/immortals-of-aveum/immortals-of-aveum/disclaimers for details.

notes.title: Get Prepped for The Echollector Update this November!
notes.content:
Hey Battlemages!

It’s time to sigil up in a big way as all-new challenges are headed to you for Immortals of Aveum™ in [b]The Echollector Update![/b] Battlemages, get ready- you’ll need quick thinking, fast reflexes, and every ounce of your magic for the adventure that lies ahead. Here’s some of what’s coming as part of our largest game update yet:

New playable content, gear, and lore in the free gameplay content update, [b]“The Echollector”[/b]
Continue the fight for Aveum with [b]New Game+[/b]
Brave the new [b]Grand Magnus difficulty[/b] and take on foes like never before 

And that’s not all! If you’re new to Immortals of Aveum, you’ll be able to start your journey in the [b]PC demo[/b] on Steam.

The Echollector Update (1.0.6.0) will arrive [b]November 16, 2023[/b] for PlayStation 5, Xbox Series X|S and PC along with the console Free Trial. The PC demo will be rolling out to Steam in the second half of November. Be sure to catch up on Immortals of Aveum’s previous updates, including key fixes for DLSS, PC mouse sensitivity, console brightness, the launch of FSR3 on PC and overall performance improvements, all of which can be found [url=https://www.ea.com/games/immortals-of-aveum/immortals-of-aveum/news#game-updates]here[/url].

Additionally, we’re [url=https://www.ea.com/games/immortals-of-aveum/immortals-of-aveum/news/update-1055]releasing an update today (1.0.5.5)[/url] that provides performance boosts on consoles and PC.

What’s New?

First and foremost, with update 1.0.6.0 comes the new lore and gameplay content for those who’ve reached the final chapters of the game.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43953575/f829817f17fafe6873f8d0f23d35147efc222e78.jpg[/img]
[b]“THE ECHOLLECTOR” Content Update[/b] is a new endgame objective for players who want more lore and new content to play through once they’ve reached the later chapters. The events of the Everwar left the Path weak, scattering chunks of the consciouscape across Aveum and creating corrupted Shatterfanes - portals to new, undiscovered areas.

Jak must rid Aveum of these Shatterfanes and put a stop to whatever malevolent forces are siphoning away the Path’s power in a new boss fight. The Shatterfanes will automatically be available upon reaching Glaivegate, giving you the chance to take on this new challenge.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43953575/daa95621a72a6bc42b5320f24989776467516e2e.jpg[/img]
Doing so will unlock new lore for you to experience and gear for you to take on your journeys through the Everwar.

[b]NEW GAME+[/b] has been one of the biggest requests we’ve gotten and we’re thrilled to be able to confirm it’s coming. NG+ will not only allow you to play through the game again with most of your abilities and spells, it’ll also give you the opportunity to further upgrade your gear and take on updated fights.

[list]
[*] Upgrade your Epic and Legendary gear to higher levels with the Forge in NG+
[*] Rebalanced enemy health, damage, and abilities
[*] Jak carries forward most spells and abilities unlocked in a previous playthrough
[*] Augment spells cannot carry forward due to their unlock requirements
[*] Adjustments made to experience and currency earned while playing
[/list]
[b]GRAND MAGNUS DIFFICULTY[/b] brings a whole new level of challenge to Aveum. Face down Sandrakk’s forces like never before in the most challenging mode yet. Every fight will be a battle for survival as you push your way through the Everwar and forge yourself into an Immortal worthy of the name.

And of course, this brand-new difficulty mode is available as a new playthrough or with New Game+!

Sigils Up!

[i]Immortals of Aveum[/i] has been a labor of love for the team. We’re glad to get to release an update like this for a project we’ve been so passionate about, and are humbled by the joy it’s brought our players.

We’re continuing to work on making it the best game it can be, and your feedback helps make that possible. Keep an eye out for the full patch notes closer to the update’s release. We hope all of you who play the game—past, present, and future—can enjoy the new content and changes coming with this update.

Have fun!


*Play up to Chapter Three. Free Trial time is subject to change. Free trial begins:
 - On PlayStation and Xbox at 9:00am PT on November 16th
 Internet connection, EA account, and acceptance of EA User Agreement (terms.ea.com) and Privacy & Cookie Policy (privacy.ea.com) may be required to play. Access on certain platforms may require a premium platform account. Additional in-game content may be available for purchase and is available for continued use in the full game; purchased content will not be refunded upon completion of the trial.

notes.content:
Hey, all!

We hope you’re enjoying the game since it launched last week! We wanted to thank you all for the support, feedback and bug reports. Our second patch update that goes live today across PC, PS5 and Xbox Series X|S brings a lot of key fixes, so please be sure to read over the release notes below.

As always, be sure to follow our social channels for the latest on Immortals of Aveum™, including any future updates for the game, as we’re going to continue making it better and adding more options and features that you’ve been requesting.

[b]Key Fixes:[/b]
[list]
[*] Increased the mouse sensitivity range so users can adjust the setting lower as needed 
[*] Fixed underlying issue that could cause console brightness to appear too dark or too bright
[/list]

[b]Game Performance:[/b]
[list]
[*] Fixed multiple instances of occasional crashes and progression blockers 
[*] Fixed an issue where game was overwriting save slots when the user spawned at a specific location 
[*] Improved various instances of FPS drops and stuttering throughout the game
[*] Addressed areas where the game would occasionally hitch or freeze momentarily 
[*] Improved loot spawn time
[/list]

[b]Gameplay:[/b]
[list]
[*] Fixed instances where objects were sometimes not appearing in the correct location
[*] Fixed various instances where spell cooldown, reload, and animations could trigger incorrectly or interfere with spell function
[*] Fixed various possible issues caused by dying and respawning
[*] Prevented spells being cast in the background of cinematics 
[*] Addressed exploits in the Chapter 2 Howler fight
[*] Addressed exploit in the Obelisk Fane
[*] Addressed display issue with Spell preview videos 
[*] Fixed various combat quirks with Archon and Red Elementals
[*] Addressed exploits when navigating the terrain in specific locations
[*] Fixed multiple areas where user could fall through map or get stuck
[*] Minor balancing and stat updates
[*] Addressed minor combat exploits 
[/list]

[b]UI/UX:[/b]
[list]
[*] Added text to display unspent Ascension points when the user earns Arcanum
[*] Various level map fixes and improvements to ensure UI elements display as intended 
[*] Fixed various instances where text did not display properly
[*] Improvements to the Performance Budget tool UI
[*] Fixes to Objective marker and Quest descriptions occasionally not displaying correctly 
[/list]

[b]PC-Specific: [/b]
[list]
[*] Dialogue options now clickable using the mouse
[*] Prevented Fury Spells from being cast during conversations with NPCs
[*] Added a loading animation on the "Optimize Game Files" screen
[*] Fixed issue where message prompts were occasionally not appearing upon changing settings
[*] Added three graphics settings: Mesh Pool Quality, Shadow Rendering Pool Size, Render Target Pool Size
[*] Fixed issue on low and min spec PCs where some settings would be set to ultra by default, causing performance problems 
[*] Fixed issues that sometimes occurred when changing the display resolution or display mode 
[/list]

[b]Misc. Changes & Minor Fixes:[/b]
[list]
[*] Made it so that tutorials related to combat appear again if you die before completing the tutorial 
[*] Added a link to a help page when the game experiences online connectivity issues
[*] Fixes for missing or mistimed subtitles 
[*] Fixed an issue where colorblind mode was displaying incorrectly 
[*] Fixed an issue where combat banter would not play during The Morbane boss battle
[*] Updated localized Privacy and Cookie Policy documents
[*] Game credits list updated
[*] Minor visual improvements and fixes throughout the game to UI, VFX, animation, cinematics, and other art
[*] Minor fixes to audio mix and SFX
[/list]

notes.title: Immortals of Aveum - Update #1 Release Notes
notes.content:
Thank you for playing [i]Immortals of Aveum[/i]™ this first week. We appreciate all of your feedback and have rolled out our first post-launch update. Follow [i]Immortals of Aveum[/i] on the social channel of your choice for details on new patches coming up.

The update for PC is available now.

[b]General Fixes[/b]
[list]
[*] Fixed broken water visual effects, including reflections and visuals while standing and firing in the water
[*] Safeguarded against crashes and progression blockers
[*] Fixed an issue with the interact point on Selko
[*] Fixed an issue where players couldn’t reach Alacrity Fane
[*] Performance improvements, including areas where in-world Corruption is present
[/list]

[b]PC-Specific[/b]
[list]
[*] Improved the shader compilation screen
[/list]
